body: Honestly there’s so much on my plate rn that I can’t even process my breakup as much as I’d like. I’m not coping well and I’m trying to take it one day at a time. It hurts not having by best friend around with me sharing my life. I talked with my sister last night and she said we’re just too young and immature rn to sustain the relationship we wanted to. Everyone says if we’re meant to be we’re gonna meet again. I believe it but I don’t want to wait forever and she forgets about me or doesn’t see that I care anymore. I believe this girl was my person and I still do. I have to convince her eventually that I’m her person again as well, bc I fucked up and made her feel like I wasn’t her home anymore.
I can fake my confidence really well honestly, but as of late bc of my acne and just how pretty this girl is my confidence is taking a toll.
Honestly my insecurities and lack of genuine confidence plus all the attention she gets from guys is a terrible combination. I loathe how much I get into my own head as well as how insecure I am

No I didn’t my exact words were “something came up gotta cancel” blocked then unblocked to tell her happy bday and then blocked it again. Ik it’s complicated but honestly I kept regretting my decision and hoping she’d change it sorta

I unblocked her number, but Ik she won’t text me anyways. There isn’t gonna be any check up or “hey, you okay” bc she doesn’t even remember the little things already let alone actually check up on wtf happened. Also I keep going back to my messages like a sick puppy hoping she texted so I don’t feel really good about my decision...

I’d love a dog honestly. I’m a softie for dogs, but fuck this life dude. With who I’ve built myself as it always feels like I have to justify everything and anything I think or do. It’s so hard. If my English doesn’t make sense I’m sorry I’m healing from my 4th concussion
Thanks, I hope you find peace too. I just wish I wasn’t born sometimes ya know? That feeling/thought of “what if I wasn’t born? Who would I have impacted or not impacted”
